findings.passage: “I’m very confident that once it's placed on the ballot, if we can get a fair wording out of the department of state, the voters will certainly approve it,” Argall said.
findings.note: Quoted by City & State PA, speaking as chair of the Senate State Government Committee about the proposed constitutional amendment requiring voters to show ID. He says voters would approve it if it reached the ballot with fair wording.
